Found 12 items in registries @waves-cn:

Showing items 1-12 of 12:

- wave-cn (registry:lib) - Core hook, player and shared defaults powering all waves-cn components. Built on wavesurfer.js. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-player (registry:component) - Full-featured wave player with play/pause, volume control, seek bar and optional title. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-recorder (registry:component) - Voice message recorder with live waveform, pause/resume, discard and auto-stop. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-speed (registry:component) - wave player with continuous playback speed control and preserve-pitch toggle. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-zoom (registry:component) - wave player with mouse-wheel zoom via wavesurfer.js ZoomPlugin. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-video (registry:component) - Waveform player synced to a video element via the wavesurfer.js media prop. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-timeline (registry:component) - wave player with timeline ruler, zoom slider and volume control powered by wavesurfer.js TimelinePlugin. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-regions (registry:component) - Wave player with interactive region markers for audio segments. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-minimap (registry:component) - Wave player with a smaller overview minimap. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-spectrogram (registry:component) - Wave player paired with a frequency spectrogram. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-hover (registry:component) - Wave player with a hover cursor and time tooltip. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- wave-envelope (registry:component) - Wave player with interactive volume automation points. [@waves-cn] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
